scope: Gate 2: Vapi chat and Telnyx inbound/outbound telephone voice, controlled by local Connect SDK/API. Live SMS deferred by owner pending approval.

acceptance.title: Durable local foundation
acceptance.proof: Start with isolated local state; prove backup-backed upgrades preserve identities, history, journal and receipts; current authorization and recovery still hold.

acceptance.title: Safe provider effects
acceptance.proof: One local message acceptance creates one provider job. Replay, shutdown and restart never blindly repeat an uncertain external mutation.

acceptance.title: Authenticated callback translation
acceptance.proof: Local signature, authorization, callback deduplication and SMS delivery correlation tests pass. Signed live SMS callback is explicitly deferred pending approval.

acceptance.title: Useful assistant chat
acceptance.proof: Two real Vapi chat turns preserve explicit chat/conversation context and commit the replies into Connect history.

acceptance.title: One developer interface
acceptance.proof: Rust, Python and TypeScript native access plus HTTP/JSON share identities, request receipts, authorization, history and inbox behavior. Run the public-SDK sample.

acceptance.title: Explicit resource setup and readiness
acceptance.proof: Use isolated assistant/test resources; select or explicitly order a number, preserve configuration, reconcile uncertainty and report actual messaging readiness. SIP resource readback is setup evidence only.

acceptance.title: Real human–assistant SMS loop
acceptance.proof: A consented handset sends a message and receives its Vapi reply; a second turn preserves context. Demonstrate assistant-initiated contact through the SDK and correlate provider delivery/failure outcomes.

acceptance.title: Reproducible local handoff
acceptance.proof: Full local runner passes at a recorded source state; real chat and both telephone directions have redacted evidence and a public SDK sample. Deferred live SMS remains visible.

acceptance.title: Outbound telephone voice
acceptance.proof: Public SDK starts one Vapi call using the owned Telnyx caller ID; the authorized handset answers and exchanges intelligible audio; call outcome and provider ID remain in the Connect conversation.

acceptance.title: Inbound telephone voice
acceptance.proof: A caller dials the owned Telnyx number and talks with the assigned Vapi assistant. Verified provider readback maps the call into the explicitly authorized Connect route and conversation.

acceptance.title: Voice lifecycle and recovery
acceptance.proof: SDK status/end, journal events, replay without redial, uncertain creation, inbound deduplication, current authority and restart are tested. Provider polling failures cannot falsely end a call.

closure_rule: All required local, Vapi chat, inbound and outbound telephone voice proofs pass with conversation correlation. Record SMS live acceptance as explicitly deferred pending approval; native QUIC audio and browser WebRTC remain Gate 3.
telephone_backend: Supported Vapi native Telnyx integration; BYO SIP alternative rejected on this account and not qualified. Native SIP media remains Gate 3.
